name: labs/f9r__ihcpmslib-wrappers
title: INHECO SCILA CO2 incubator (ihcWrappers.scila.ScilaWrapper)
intro: INHECO SCILA CO2 incubator (ihcWrappers.scila.ScilaWrapper), adapted from f9r/ihcpmslib-wrappers. It reads `device_name`, `firmware_version`, `state`, `current_temperature` and 8 more; sets `auto_boost_co2`; runs `set_temperature` and `stop_incubation`. `set_temperature`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
